messages.subject: Error in survey report
parts:
Hi,

I get the following error when I run survey report:

Error in surveyReport(recordTable = sppRT, CTtable = camtraps, camOp = camop_problem,  :  camOp may only contain positive values (set scaleEffort = FALSE in cameraOperation().

I am still able to get Detection History if I move beyond surveyReport. Here is the code I used:

report <- surveyReport(recordTable = sppRT, # Species record table
                       CTtable = camtraps, # the CT table
                       camOp = camop_problem,
                       speciesCol = "Species", #column containing species ID in the record table
                       stationCol = "Station",
                       setupCol = "Setup_date", # column containing the camera setup dates in the CT table
                       retrievalCol = "Retrieval_date",
                       CTDateFormat = "%Y%m%d", # date format in the CT table
                       recordDateTimeCol = "DateTimeOriginal",
                       recordDateTimeFormat = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
                       sinkpath = getwd()
                       )

Any help on how to get survey report is greatly appreciated. Thanks,

Celso A. Poot

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Error in survey report
parts:
Hi,
the error says: " camOp may only contain positive values (set scaleEffort = FALSE in cameraOperation()."
Did you try creating the camera operation matrix with scaleEffort = FALSE, i.e.:

camop_problem  <- cameraOperation(..., scaleEffort= FALSE)

I can't think of any other reason why there would be negative values in the camera operation matrix.
Best regards,
Jürgen

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Error in survey report
parts:
Hi,
my previous reply was wrong, sorry. cameraOperation() does not have a scaleEffort argument (anymore) and the error message was outdated in the package.

The error about negative effort in the camera operation matrix likely occurred because of some days being in multiple Problem_from/to periods. They are then subtracted from effort multiple times, leading to negative effort.

The current GitHub version should give a better error message with station and days for which the problem occurs,
something like:
Error: Negative effort calculated in StationA__CAM_Camera1 on: Date1, Date2
 Check for overlapping dates in Problem columns

The check is currently for each station individually, not all at once. A bit inconvenient if it affects multiple stations, but at least not misleading anymore.
Best regards,
Jürgen

parts:
Hi,

the expected format does not have dashes, but the actual data do. Did you specify argument CTDateFormat? By default it should be CTDateFormat = "ymd", using the simpler lubridate format and not the base R format (with %). In that case the error message should be different though.

Can you confirm that this still happens with the latest version from Github? If so please share a small subset of the data so I can investigate.  If not please update and try again.

Thank you
